properties.headline: Flood Warning issued November 10 at 1:15PM CST until November 11 at 5:20PM CST by NWS Austin/San Antonio TX
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in Texas...

Llano River at Llano affecting Llano County.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is occurring and moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHERE...Llano River at Llano.

* WHEN...Until Wednesday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 12.0 feet, Moderate lowland flooding makes secondary
roads and low bridges in the flood plain dangerous to motorists
including the low water crossing of Ranch Road 3404/Slab Road near
Kingsland. Equipment should be moved from low docks and boat ties
loosened downstream in Kingsland.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1:00 PM CST Tuesday the stage was 14.0 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 10.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 1:00 PM CST Tuesday was 14.2 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage late
tonight and continue falling to 3.8 feet early Sunday afternoon.
- Flood stage is 10.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 12.6
feet on 06/01/2016.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued November 10 at 10:02PM PST until November 11 at 4:01PM PST by NWS Seattle WA
properties.description:
...Forecast flooding changed from Minor to Moderate severity and
increased in duration for the following rivers in Washington...

Skokomish River At Potlatch affecting Mason County.

.Heavy rainfall over the Olympics earlier today has mostly ended, but
flooding on the Skokomish River will continue into Wednesday the the
flood crest moves downstream.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHERE...Skokomish River at Potlatch.

* WHEN...Until Wednesday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 17.5 feet, the Skokomish River will cause moderate
flooding, with deep and quick flood waters inundating some
residential areas, many roads, and much of the farm land in the
Skokomish Valley. Inundated roads include the Skokomish Valley
road, Bourgault Road West, Purdy Cutoff Road, and Highway 106.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:30 PM PST Tuesday the stage was 17.4 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 9:30 PM PST Tuesday was 17.4 feet.
- Forecast...The river will crest around 17.5 feet later tonight.
It will then fall below flood stage around midday Wednesday.
Another return to flood stage is possible late this week.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
